events.what: Jafari proves the online (stronger) form of the List Edge-Coloring Conjecture for complete graphs K_{p-1} and K_{2p}, p an odd prime

judgement.doubts: Codes agree. The record's reasoning is off, though: it treats the result as 'checkable' because it is a self-contained argument. It is not checkable in the §3 sense. It is an unreviewed preprint. That makes no difference here, because a case is partial whatever its verification. The online form is stronger than the list form, so it implies the bullet's statement for these families and is a case, not a variant. The v2 of 2026-09-16 does not move the date.
